coordinates: glTF world metres (x, y up, z); authoring y = -z
semantics: Indoor rooms for tools/check-sky.py's enclosure test. From every walkable eye inside a box, a view ray that reaches the sky (meets no world geometry) must leave the box through one of its openFaces (+x,-x,+y,-y,+z,-z). A sky ray through any other face is a leak, e.g. a ceiling that stops short of a wall. Optional openings are boxes (glTF metres) on closed faces: a sky ray whose exit point lies in one leaves through a door, not a leak.

rooms.note: North face (+z) is the designed wide opening onto the vista and the service-descent threshold; the east exit passage leaves through +x.
Enclosed service descent under its sloping roof; open at both ends (hall service entry, vault threshold).
Covered passage from the Sun Court to the Array Hall, open at both ends.

0.10.1: enclosed on three sides, walls up into the roof beams. The north panorama (-z) is the designed open vista. Doors: vestibule, annex door, balcony portal (4 m), service passage, and the 16 m rooftop walkway's west and south doors.
